title: 第一卷 第25章 真碰上了第一卷 第26章 还好来得及时
lines: 秦烈用望气术看了一眼。
不看不知道，一看吓一跳。
四面八方都有妖气，数量还不少。
“来了不少东西啊。”
李虎握着刀问：“多少？”
秦烈又扫了一圈，心里大概数了数。
“保守估计有二十多只，估计更多。妖兽、小妖，乱七八糟的什么都有。”
李虎活动了一下脖子，骨头咔咔响了几声。
“那估计狼魁是真急了，家底儿都掏出来送给咱们砍了。”
许青禾收起了手中的册子，换成了一柄短剑。
“不要恋战，我们今天的目的是抓狼魁，跟这些小妖纠缠久了会耽误事儿。”
李虎伸手摸了摸下巴。
“道理是这么个道理，不过他们已经堵在路中间不让走了。”
“我要是从旁边绕过去，还让人以为我怕了他们呢，那多掉价呀！”
话没说完，第一只妖兽就从林子里扑了出来。
李虎一步踏出去，长刀横着一扫。
噗！
妖兽脑袋飞了，黑色的血液溅的旁边树干上都是。
紧接着，更多妖物冲了出来。
秦烈能感觉到这一波的攻势跟上一波明显不一样了。
第一波攻击缩手缩脚的，主要是试探。
这一波，一个个眼睛通红，明显是要拼命了。
不知道是不是错觉，他们眼中充满了恐惧。
害怕还往前冲，那估计不是害怕他们三个，而是害怕身后的狼魁。
李虎吼了一嗓子，直接扎进妖群里。
他这刀法跟秦烈不一样。
秦烈的刀法很简单，劈、撩、挡，来来回回就那三招。
李虎的刀法明显霸道许多。
一刀下去，不管是妖兽还是小妖，挨上了就缺胳膊少腿。
有只小妖想绕到他背后偷袭，李虎头都没回，一脚就把它胸口踹塌了，倒飞出去撞树上，当场没声。
秦烈看了一眼，心里直咋舌。
这人平时大大咧咧没个正形，真打起来是真够狠的，怪不得能在镇妖司混到现在。
不过秦烈也没光顾着看热闹。
一只狼形妖兽从侧面扑来，张嘴就咬他胳膊。
秦烈脚下一错避开，刀顺势从上往下一斩。
噗！
content_en:
Qin Lie used his Qi-gazing technique to take a look.
You won’t know if you don’t look at it, but you will be shocked when you look at it.
There are monsters everywhere, and there are quite a lot of them.
"A lot of things have come."
Li Hu held the knife and asked, "How much?"
Qin Lie scanned around again and counted them in his mind.
"A conservative estimate is that there are more than twenty, probably more. There are monsters, little monsters, and everything in between."
Li Hu moved his neck, and his bones clicked a few times.
"Then I guess Lang Kuai is really anxious. He took out all his family's money and gave it to us to chop it up."
Xu Qinghe put away the book in his hand and replaced it with a short sword.
"Don't be obsessed with fighting. Our purpose today is to capture the leader of the wolf. Being entangled with these little monsters for too long will delay things."
Li Hu reached out and touched his chin.
"That's the truth, but they have blocked the middle of the road and won't let you go."
"If I go around and people think I'm afraid of them, that'll be a huge price drop!"
Before he finished speaking, the first monster jumped out of the forest.
Li Hu stepped out with a single step and swiped his long knife horizontally.
puff!
The monster's head flew away, and black blood splashed all over the tree trunk next to it.
Immediately afterwards, more monsters rushed out.
Qin Lie could feel that this wave of offensive was obviously different from the previous wave.
The first wave of attacks were timid, mainly for testing.
In this wave, everyone's eyes were red, and they were obviously desperate.
Not sure if it was an illusion, but their eyes were filled with fear.
If he rushed forward out of fear, he was probably not afraid of the three of them, but of the wolf leader behind him.
"Kill!"
Li Hu roared and plunged directly into the demon group.
His sword skills are different from Qin Lie's.
Qin Lie's sword skills are very simple, just three moves: chopping, teasing, and blocking.
Li Hu's sword skills are obviously much more domineering.
With one strike, no matter whether it is a monster or a small demon, it will be missing arms and legs.
There was a little demon that wanted to sneak up on him, but Li Hu didn't even turn around. He kicked it in the chest and flew backwards into a tree, making no sound on the spot.
Qin Lie glanced at it and was speechless.
This person is usually very carefree but he is really ruthless when it comes to fighting. No wonder he has been able to survive in the Demon Suppression Division until now.
But Qin Lie didn't just watch the fun.
A wolf-shaped monster rushed from the side, opened its mouth and bit his arm.
Qin Lie made a mistake with his foot to avoid it, and slashed downwards with his sword.
puff!
